name: Consumption statement
description: Statement grouping consumption amounts for allocation, encoding and accounting integration.

condo_id.label: Condominium
condo_id.help: All related records must belong to this condominium.

fiscal_year_id.label: Fiscal year
fiscal_year_id.description: Fiscal year associated with the statement.
fiscal_year_id.help: Its start date is used for the first statement of a file.

fiscal_period_id.label: Fiscal period
fiscal_period_id.description: Fiscal period associated with the statement.
fiscal_period_id.help: The period must belong to the selected fiscal year and condominium.

date_from.label: Start date
date_from.description: First day included in the statement period.
date_from.help: It follows the latest completed statement or defaults to the fiscal year start.

date_to.label: End date
date_to.description: Last day included in the statement period.
date_to.help: It is proposed as one calendar year minus one day after the start date.

misc_operation_id.label: Accounting operation
misc_operation_id.help: This value is assigned by the accounting integration.

posting_date.label: Posting date
posting_date.description: Date on which the statement must be posted.

document_id.label: Document
document_id.help: Select the source document received from the supplier.

consumption_meter_id.label: Legacy meter
consumption_meter_id.description: Former master meter linked to the statement.
consumption_meter_id.help: This optional hidden field is retained for existing data.

consumption_file_id.label: Consumption file
consumption_file_id.description: Configuration file used by the statement.
consumption_file_id.help: Changing it in draft preserves existing allocations and adds those of the new file.

consumption_statement_lines_ids.label: Lines
consumption_statement_lines_ids.description: Amounts assigned to property lots and ownership periods.
consumption_statement_lines_ids.help: Lines are editable only in the to-encode status.

consumption_statement_allocations_ids.label: Allocations
consumption_statement_allocations_ids.description: Amounts allocated to accounting accounts and apportionments.
consumption_statement_allocations_ids.help: Allocations are editable in draft and proforma.

statement_total.label: Statement total
statement_total.description: Total amount shown on the statement.
statement_total.help: Allocation and line totals are checked against this amount.

status.label: Status
status.help: The workflow only allows forward transitions.

form.default.name: Consumption statement
form.default.description: Maintain a consumption statement through its processing workflow.

action.send.label: Send
action.send.description: Mark the statement as sent after checking allocations.

action.generate_lines.label: Generate lines
action.generate_lines.description: Generate missing lines from configured property lots.

action.encode.label: Mark encoded
action.encode.description: Mark the statement as encoded after checking all totals.

errors.statement_not_draft: The consumption file can only be changed while the statement is in draft.
errors.invalid_status: Lines can only be generated while the statement is in the to-encode status.
errors.missing_allocation_apportionment: Every allocation must have an apportionment before the statement can be encoded.
errors.allocations_total_mismatch: The allocation total must match the statement total.
errors.lines_total_mismatch: The line total must match the statement total.
errors.missing_rounding_account: A rounding account is required to balance the statement allocations.
errors.missing_rounding_account_apportionment: The rounding account must have an apportionment.
errors.accounting_operation_already_exists: An accounting operation already exists for this statement.
errors.missing_misc_journal: A miscellaneous operations journal is required for integration.
errors.missing_private_expense_account: A private expense account is required for integration.
